check: Every committed story has Given/When/Then criteria with an unhappy path that pass the SMART-style checks before sprint planning
sample: All 12 stories committed to sprints S1 and S2

check: Every merge to main is approved by an engineer who did not write it
finding: 3 merges were self-approved during the identity-provider sandbox outage (issue I001)
action: Turn on branch protection on main requiring one approval with no bypass; noted in DoD v1.2

check: Every item demonstrated at the sprint review met every DoD line including the WCAG 2.2 AA check
sample: All 9 stories shown at the sprint S4 review
finding: Two stories with colour-contrast failures (DEF-003 and DEF-004) reached the S4 review and were accepted with conditions (ACT005); the manual accessibility scan was skipped under deadline pressure
action: Make the WCAG 2.2 AA scan a blocking pipeline step; state in DoD v1.2 that an item failing any line is not done and is not shown as done at the review

check: Acceptance evidence comes from the real environment on current data
sample: Test runs for the 9 stories of sprint S4
finding: The reset and order journeys were verified only against the identity-provider stub (DEC001) and stale QA data caused false failures (issue I003)
action: Repeat the journey tests against the real identity provider before gate G2 (ACT003); refresh QA data nightly from a masked snapshot; DoD v1.2 requires the real provider for sign-in evidence

check: Every escaped defect is root-caused and the process gap closed (audit triggered by the escaped severity-2 DEF-008)
sample: Defects found in the pilot so far (DEF-008 and DEF-009) and the pilot defect removal efficiency to date
finding: Pilot DRE to date is 75% against the 90% target; both escapes trace to requirements nobody stated (session time-out and order-status freshness)
action: Add time-outs and data freshness to the non-functional probe list used with scope-and-requirements and to the criteria review checklist; add a time-out and a freshness scenario to every journey's criteria

check: Every defect has severity and stage found and WBS id and requirement id and an owner; closed defects were retested by someone other than the fixer
sample: All 41 defects logged since sprint S1
finding: 4 of 41 defects had no requirement id
action: Make req_id a mandatory tracker field and backfill the 4 before gate G4
